scripts.name: fright
scripts.note: blue for a while, then flashing; slow, anywhere; Pac-Man eats it

scripts.name: eyes

lines.note: tell the game: PLAY counts it

scripts.note: eaten: only its eyes go home, fast, to the door; they meet nothing

scripts.name: entering
scripts.note: at the door (the game says): its eyes in, down to the middle of the house; alive, out again

scripts.name: hidden
scripts.note: gone a while (Pac-Man dying, the level eaten): the game starts it anew

scripts.name: parade
scripts.note: entry: the title show starts it; after Pac-Man

above: A ghost, all it does: bobbing in the house till its turn, out through the door, hunting in the maze,
frightened, eaten, its eyes home and in through the door, out again. In the maze the game walks it from the middle
of a cell to the next (dgx_ge_walk.h) toward the cell it aims at (tcol, trow) at its speed (speed), and tells it
its way; in the house its own path moves it. Where it aims is the arcade's, by who: Blinky at Pac-Man's cell, Pinky
four cells ahead of him, Inky past two ahead as far again as Blinky is from there, Clyde at Pac-Man when far and
at his corner when near; scattering, each at its corner; frightened, anywhere. Its body (the mask GHOST) catches
Pac-Man, or is eaten by him frightened (its hit). The four are one kind: the game draws each with its colors
(param who: the palettes PINKY, INKY, CLYDE). What it asks the game (game.*): where Pac-Man is (his cell, his way),
where Blinky is, its own cell, the mode, the dots left, whether it is in a tunnel, which ghost is the next in the
house, the dots eaten, the door and the middle of the house.

lines.note: tell the game: PLAY counts it

above: The fruit under the house: shown a while when PLAY says (SIG_FRUIT); Pac-Man meeting it eats it (its hit).

scripts.name: blink
above: Words on the screen: the prompt of the title blinks.

scripts.name: schedule
above: The schedule of the ghosts' modes, level 1: a signal to the game as each begins. The game starts it
with a life (an actor of its own, not drawn); its clock stands while the ghosts are frightened.

params.name: eaten
params.note: dots and energizers eaten on this level

params.name: bonus
params.note: what the next ghost of this fright is worth

params.name: extra
params.note: 1: the extra life of this game is given

scripts.name: title
scripts.note: the title show plays (the game's)

scripts.name: level
scripts.note: the dots anew

scripts.name: ready
scripts.note: everyone where they start, READY! a while, then the game goes

lines.name: idle
lines.note: anew: no dot for so long, the house lets one out

scripts.name: fruit_comes
scripts.note: under the house, for a while (the fruit's own time)

scripts.name: scored
scripts.note: the numbers shown anew; an extra life once a game

scripts.name: ate_ghost
scripts.note: 200, 400, 800, 1600 in one fright: all stands a while, its points shown

scripts.name: release
scripts.note: no dot eaten for so long: the next ghost out, and the time anew

scripts.name: caught
scripts.note: a ghost has him: all stands a second, then he dies (the ghosts go)

scripts.name: life_lost
scripts.note: he is gone (the game says): again, or the game is over

scripts.name: cleared
scripts.note: the level eaten: all stands, the maze flashes, the next level

lines.name: WORDS_GAME_OVER
lines.note: a start in this second is not taken

above: The game itself as an actor: its numbers, its phases and how long each lasts, and the word it shows (READY!,
GAME OVER: the game draws it in the zone message). The game tells it what happened and reads its phase (what moves
now: PH_*) and its numbers (PACMAN_PLAY_PARAM_*); the pause dialog shows them. Its signals: SIG_NUMBERS the
numbers changed, SIG_LAY the dots anew (a game, a level), SIG_PLACE everyone where they start, SIG_DIE Pac-Man dies
(the ghosts go), SIG_HIDE the ghosts and the fruit go (the level eaten), SIG_WHITE and SIG_BLUE the maze flashing,
SIG_FRUIT the fruit comes, SIG_RELEASE the next ghost out of the house (no dot eaten for a while: the timer idle),
SIG_OVER the game is over, SIG_TITLE the title again.

dialogs.name: pause
dialogs.text:
dialog pause
roles play PLAY
game PLAY
style menu
pause
    say game "PAUSE  Score {score}  Lives {lives}"
choose play
    "Continue" -> resume
    "New game" -> restart
label resume
    end
label restart
    tell play restart
    end
